_comment: Claude Code MCP config template. Merge contents into your local ~/.claude.json under the mcpServers key (do NOT replace the whole file — it contains other Claude Code settings). Easier alternative: run the equivalent CLI command shown below. Replace the <YOUR_*_KEY> placeholders with real keys.
_cli_equivalent: claude mcp add -s user tooluniverse -e PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 -e NCBI_API_KEY=<key> -e NVIDIA_API_KEY=<key> -e FDA_API_KEY=<key> -- uvx tooluniverse
